heroDescription: Explore 73 components and layouts. Adjust settings, try their interactions, and copy Go examples into your application.
installNote: Requires Go 1.27.3 or later. Set CGO_ENABLED to 0 when running desktop applications.
exampleDefault: These are the example settings. A Go zero value in the API table may differ from the component’s default behavior.
noParameters: This example has no separate parameters. Try the primary and neutral palette controls above.
copyFailed: Clipboard access failed. Select the code to copy it.
codeHint: Save the complete program as main.go in an initialized Go module with the dependency installed, then run it with CGO_ENABLED=0. Use the component snippet inside an existing view.
defaultCode: Copying is paused until the preview confirms the settings. The code shown is the last confirmed version, or the default example on first load.
optionHint: Supply a value of the type shown. See the complete program for usage.
optionalHint: Leave unset for the component default. Use nui.Set(false) or nui.Set(0) to explicitly disable an option or set zero.
callbackHint: A function supplied by the application and called for the corresponding event. See the complete program for an example.
stylesHint: Customize parts such as the label, icon or panel.
platformNote: The preview runs Go components in the browser. Fonts and system input can differ from desktop behavior; MyGo native file dialogs and full screen-reader support are not available.
footer: Built on MyGo · Nuxt UI visual style · MIT
imageSize: Images must be smaller than 2 MB.
parameterHint: Start with the common settings below. Expand All fields for more options, or reset the example to restore its initial settings.
apiHint: A Go zero value is the value of an unassigned field; the component may apply a different default, as described below. An unset Optional uses the default behavior, while false and zero can be set explicitly.
